U.coverage: production React render and FileBuffer/OfficeBuffer state projections

I.coverage: actual XLSX Worker/FileService/native read/save/checkpoint and independent OfficeWorkbook readback; no calculation engine supplies actual cached fallback

actualResult: Starting and refreshing show disabled input; actual loaded workbook transitions ready/editable with explicit cached formula warning; external source refresh readback matches without source write.
Real chmod444 source shows readonly, rejects pending edits and service mutation with PERMISSION.
Injected native checkpoint IO failure retains live model/local dirty candidate/original source; clearing fault saves through real services and independent OOXML readback sees candidate.
Actual external source modification triggers distinct conflict, keeps local dirty model and external disk bytes.
Unsupported viewer kind and 40 MiB+1 source retain visible error, no editable model and no native save.

validation.initial: 4/6 passed; two failed because the newly assembled test adapter omitted recalculateOffice required by actual save flow. Added only forwarding to real service; no production behavior changed.
validation.typecheck: shared full pnpm typecheck exit0 before test adapter forwarding addition; final package check records later validation

boundaries: Starting/live/refreshing/blocked/fallback map to production loadState/busy/editable/calculation, not fabricated reference enum names.
One checkpoint dispatch fault is injected; source changes and subsequent checkpoint/save are real.
React server-render assertions are U/component evidence, not App A. Original case requires U+I only.
